subject: Pipeline audit: locking commits & churn mitigation for upcoming renewal window
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>, Harper Young <harper@brightbyte.com>
Cc: accounts@brightbyte.com
Date: 2026-06-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pipeline audit: locking commits & churn mitigation for upcoming renewal window

Team / Harper —

We’re starting a quick pipeline audit for BrightByte ahead of their 7/15 renewal date. Finance needs a locked commit by 6/24 to finish billing projections and prepare the renewal invoice. Please do the following by EOD 6/24: 

- Sales: confirm committed ARR in HubSpot (use the "Commit Lock" checkbox on the deal record) and note any pending approvals that could change the number.
- CSM (Marissa): confirm active seat counts and call out any 30-day usage drops or paused integrations that might trigger churn.
- Customer (Harper/accounts): confirm there are no outstanding procurement items that could delay signature (POs, internal approvals).

I’ve attached the commit_runbook_v2.xlsx with the fields Finance needs (effective date, ARR, prorate rules, backup contact). I’ll consolidate and hand off to Finance on 6/25 morning. If any of you foresee a >10% delta from current forecast please flag ASAP so we can run a short risk-mitigation play.

Quick ask for Harper: if you expect any change to headcount or product mix before 7/15 that would affect ARR, please reply here with the estimate so we can model proration.

Thanks —
Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
(Attachment: commit_runbook_v2.xlsx)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>, Harper Young <harper@brightbyte.com>
Date: 2026-06-18T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pipeline audit: locking commits & churn mitigation for upcoming renewal window

Thanks Naomi — quick status:

- Current HubSpot committed ARR: $375k ARR (deal stage: Commit).
- Open procurement item: PO pending from procurement legal (expected sign-off 6/29).
- Sales confidence: 85% based on exec alignment call last week.

I’ll update the Commit Lock checkbox by EOD 6/22 with the note about the procurement timeline. If the PO slips past 6/29 we should consider a temporary defer clause in the SOW to capture the current rate.

Ben Carter
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Harper Young <harper@brightbyte.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: accounts@brightbyte.com
Date: 2026-06-18T13:19:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pipeline audit: locking commits & churn mitigation for upcoming renewal window

Hi Naomi and team —

Thanks for the heads up. A couple notes from BrightByte: 

- Procurement is targeting 6/29 for final PO approval; internal finance is on board but legal has one outstanding clause.
- We’re planning a small headcount change (two engineers moved off the platform) effective 7/1. Estimated ARR impact: ~8% (roughly $30k annualized).
- Accounts payable can sign on receipt of the final invoice; no issues anticipated with payment terms.

If you need formal confirmation we can send a short note from procurement by 6/22. Otherwise consider the 8% headcount change as the expected variance.

—Harper
Harper Young
VP Customer Success, BrightByte

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>, Harper Young <harper@brightbyte.com>
Date: 2026-06-19T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pipeline audit: locking commits & churn mitigation for upcoming renewal window

Looping in our churn signals — I pulled usage and health metrics for BrightByte this morning. Key observations: 

- Monthly active users down 22% from peak over the last 60 days; biggest drop in ingestion pipeline monitoring product.
- Two integration connectors show repeated failure events (support tickets open, highest severity last week).
- NPS for the account moved from +31 to +12 in the last survey window.

I attached a short summary (churn_evidence_summary.pdf) and recommended playbook: 1) immediate engineering triage on the connectors, 2) executive check-in with Harper and their CTO to confirm roadmap alignment, 3) provisional credit if signoff is delayed due to our remediation timeline.

If Sales wants to keep full ARR in the commit, we should formalize the remediation timeline and include a short rollback clause in the renewal SOW. Otherwise, mark the commit as "at-risk" and model the 8% headcount reduction plus a 10% usage-driven churn probability.

Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
(Attachment: churn_evidence_summary.pdf)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>, Harper Young <harper@brightbyte.com>
Cc: accounts@brightbyte.com
Date: 2026-06-19T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pipeline audit: locking commits & churn mitigation for upcoming renewal window

Thanks all — consolidated next steps below (locking commits & finance handoff):

1) Sales (Ben): Update HubSpot Commit Lock by 6/22. If procurement sends the formal PO earlier, note the PO number on the deal record. If legal pushes the PO beyond 6/29, set the deal to "Commit - Contingent" and flag Finance.
2) CSM (Marissa): Start engineering triage and schedule an executive CTO sync with Harper before 6/26. If we can’t remediate by 6/30, prepare a proposed credit figure for Finance.
3) Customer (Harper): Please send the procurement confirmation note by 6/22 if possible; also confirm final headcount impact (the ~8% estimate).
4) Finance handoff: I will deliver the locked excel and notes to Finance on 6/25 morning; they will generate a draft invoice and DocuSign envelope for signature.

If any party expects the delta to exceed 12% total ARR, escalate to me immediately and I’ll set up an emergency forecast sync with FinOps.

I’ll update the HubSpot link and DocuSign draft here after the handoff.

Naomi
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
(Links: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/BrightByte , https://www.docusign.com/ct/some-docusign-link/7832)
